docgen.longDescription: 日本語の文章規範と説明ドキュメントの構成、単一ファイル HTML のデザインシステム
defaultPrompt: Explain this concept as an HTML document

runbook.longDescription: Create and review concise runbooks that run top to bottom without judgment from whoever executes them, settling every decision as you write instead of leaving it to the person running the procedure.
defaultPrompt: Create a runbook for this task

actions-ubuntu-slim-migration.longDescription: Analyze GitHub Actions workflows and migrate them from ubuntu-latest to ubuntu-slim, adding back only the tooling each job actually needs to cut runner cost.

cloud-logging.longDescription: Query and narrow down Google Cloud Logging entries with an approach that keeps large log volumes from flooding the context window.
defaultPrompt: Investigate errors in Cloud Logging for this service

codex.longDescription: Ask the OpenAI Codex CLI for an autonomous second opinion, or run its built-in read-only review mode over the current changes.
defaultPrompt: Review my current changes with Codex

difit.longDescription: Open a diff in difit and round-trip review comments between the local reviewer UI and the agent.
defaultPrompt: Open this diff in difit for review

github-copilot.longDescription: Ask the GitHub Copilot CLI for a second AI opinion, or request a Copilot review on a pull request.
defaultPrompt: Ask Copilot to review this change

google-style-guide.longDescription: Write, edit, and review developer documentation following the Google developer documentation style guide, with separate English and Japanese skills.
defaultPrompt: Review this README against the Google style guide

hydra-experiment.longDescription: Set up and run machine learning experiments managed by Hydra, covering config composition, sweeps, and run layout.
defaultPrompt: Set up Hydra config for this training script

jupyter.longDescription: Run local notebooks against a remote Jupyter Server kernel (RunPod, GCP, or self-hosted) through jupyter-mcp-server, including SSH tunnel setup.
defaultPrompt: Connect this notebook to my remote Jupyter kernel

kaggle-helper.longDescription: Analyze Kaggle discussions and notebooks, and explore the Meta Kaggle dataset, to research a competition.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the top discussions for this competition

runpod.longDescription: Manage RunPod GPU cloud resources: create pods, check GPU availability, and upload models to a Network Volume.

things-app.longDescription: Read and update personal tasks in the Things 3 app on macOS: triage the inbox, review today's list, create tasks with project/area/tags/dates, and complete them.

uv-features.longDescription: Nudges the agent toward powerful uv capabilities instead of plain pip/python: PEP 723 inline script metadata, uv run --with, uvx for one-off CLI tools, and multi-stage Docker builds.
defaultPrompt: Turn this script into a PEP 723 self-contained script

vertexai-gemini-batch.longDescription: Generate batch input files and run Vertex AI Batch Prediction jobs for Gemini models.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Gemini batch prediction job

x-research.shortDescription: Research X via the Grok API
x-research.longDescription: Research a topic on X (Twitter) through the xAI Grok API's x_search tool, returning a report backed by verbatim quotes from the actual posts and citation-verified links.

zoom.longDescription: Extract transcripts and download videos from Zoom recording share pages.
defaultPrompt: Get the transcript from this Zoom recording
